title: Hello everyone, the latest DEV support GlucoRx Aidex as blood sugar use, my country has this blood glucose meter, please how do I start setting up to use
symptom: The user asks how to start setting up to use GlucoRx Aidex as a blood sugar source in the latest DEV version of AndroidAPS, as they have this glucose meter in their country.
cause: The feature is not yet available because the GlucoRx app that would support it has not been released, and Aidex support for xDrip is in the works but not yet merged.
fix: No fix is available yet; the user must wait for the GlucoRx app release and for Aidex support to be merged into xDrip.
evidence_quote: This is not yet available. GlucoRx app that will support this was not yet released. @mick711 Aidex support for Xdrip is also in the works, but was not yet merged. But until GlucoRx app supports it you won't be able to test it.
